points.title: 农家童年
points.description: 孟德尔出生于奥地利西里西亚的一个农民家庭，父母是安东和罗西娜·门德尔。作为家中唯一的孩子，他在小农场的环境中长大，这培养了他对植物和自然的早期兴趣。家庭经济条件有限，但父母重视教育，确保他接受了基础教育。这段农村生活经历为他后来的植物学研究奠定了基础，也塑造了他严谨细致的观察习惯。
points.descriptionEn: Mendel was born to Anton and Rosine Mendel in a peasant family in Austrian Silesia. As an only child, he grew up in a small rural farm environment, which cultivated his early interest in plants and nature. Despite limited family finances, his parents valued education and ensured he received basic schooling. This rural upbringing laid the foundation for his later botanical research and shaped his meticulous observational habits.

points.title: 修道院生活
points.description: 1843年，孟德尔进入奥古斯丁会的圣托马斯修道院，成为一名修道士。在修道院中，他接受了系统的神学和哲学教育，同时继续自然科学的学习。1847年，他被任命为神父。这段时期，他开始担任家庭教师，教授数学和希腊语，同时积极参与修道院的管理工作。修道院的生活为他提供了稳定的学术环境和研究资源。
points.descriptionEn: In 1843, Mendel entered the Augustinian Abbey of St. Thomas in Brünn, becoming a friar. There, he received systematic education in theology and philosophy while continuing his studies in natural sciences. In 1847, he was ordained as a priest. During this period, he worked as a tutor, teaching mathematics and Greek, while actively participating in the monastery's administrative affairs. The monastic life provided him with a stable academic environment and research resources.

points.title: 深造学习
points.description: 1851年，孟德尔被送往维也纳大学深造，师从著名物理学家克里斯蒂安·多普勒和植物学家弗朗茨·翁格。在那里，他学习了物理学、数学、化学和植物学，特别受到物理学实验方法论的深刻影响。这段学习经历使他掌握了严谨的科学实验方法和统计分析技巧，为他后来的豌豆杂交实验奠定了方法论基础。1853年，他完成学业返回布吕恩。
points.descriptionEn: In 1851, Mendel was sent to the University of Vienna for advanced studies, under renowned physicist Christian Doppler and botanist Franz Unger. There, he studied physics, mathematics, chemistry, and botany, particularly influenced by the methodology of experimental physics. This educational experience equipped him with rigorous scientific experimental methods and statistical analysis techniques, laying the methodological foundation for his later pea hybridization experiments. He completed his studies and returned to Brünn in 1853.

points.title: 豌豆实验
points.description: 1854年，孟德尔开始在布吕恩的修道院花园进行著名的豌豆杂交实验。他精心选择了七对可区分的性状，进行了长达八年的系统实验，观察了超过28,000株植物。通过严谨的统计分析和数学方法，他发现了遗传的基本规律，后来被称为'孟德尔定律'，包括分离定律和自由组合定律。1865年，他在布吕恩自然科学学会上报告了这些发现，并于次年发表了《植物杂交实验》论文。这一时期的工作奠定了现代遗传学的基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1854, Mendel began his famous pea hybridization experiments in the monastery garden in Brünn. He carefully selected seven pairs of distinguishable traits and conducted systematic experiments over eight years, observing more than 28,000 plants. Through rigorous statistical analysis and mathematical methods, he discovered the fundamental laws of inheritance, later known as 'Mendel's Laws,' including the Law of Segregation and the Law of Independent Assortment. In 1865, he presented these findings to the Brünn Natural History Society and published his paper 'Experiments on Plant Hybridization' the following year. This work laid the foundation of modern genetics.

points.title: 修道院长与晚年
points.description: 1868年，孟德尔被任命为修道院院长，行政事务占据了他大部分时间。尽管如此，他仍继续科学研究，但未能复制豌豆实验的成功。他的遗传学理论在当时未被科学界理解和接受，直到1900年才被重新发现。晚年，他因心脏病和肾脏疾病而健康恶化，于1884年去世。作为修道院长，他推动了布吕恩地区的经济发展，包括建设水电站和改善道路。他的科学成就直到死后多年才得到广泛认可，被誉为'遗传学之父'。
points.descriptionEn: In 1868, Mendel was elected abbot of the monastery, and administrative duties consumed most of his time. Despite this, he continued scientific research but failed to replicate the success of his pea experiments. His genetic theories were not understood or accepted by the scientific community until their rediscovery in 1900. In his later years, his health declined due to heart and kidney disease, and he died in 1884. As abbot, he promoted economic development in the Brünn region, including constructing a power plant and improving roads. His scientific achievements were not widely recognized until many years after his death, earning him the title 'Father of Genetics.'

appraisal.zh: 孟德尔被公认为现代遗传学之父，他以豌豆杂交实验和数学分析发现遗传的基本规律，为分子生物学、基因工程及农业育种与医学研究奠定基础，其工作被视为科学方法的典范。也有研究者指出，他所选性状过于简单，数据或有修饰，且未能与当时的细胞学知识结合，发表后长期被忽视；他的理论直到1900年被三位科学家独立重新发现，才印证了其超前性。
appraisal.en: Mendel is widely acknowledged as the father of modern genetics: his pea hybridization experiments and mathematical analysis uncovered the fundamental laws of inheritance, laying foundations for molecular biology, genetic engineering, agricultural breeding, and medical research, and his work is taken as a model of scientific method. Some researchers note that the traits he chose were overly simple, that his data may have been cleaned, and that he failed to link his findings with contemporary cytology; neglected for decades, his theories were only independently rediscovered in 1900 by three scientists, confirming how far ahead of his time he was.

supporter.zh: 孟德尔被誉为现代遗传学之父，他的豌豆杂交实验开创了科学遗传学研究的新纪元。他通过严谨的实验设计和数学分析方法，发现了遗传的基本规律，为后来的分子生物学和基因工程奠定了基础。他的工作体现了科学方法的精髓：精确观察、量化分析和大胆假设。孟德尔的研究不仅改变了生物学的发展方向，也为农业育种和医学研究提供了理论支持。
supporter.en: Mendel is hailed as the father of modern genetics. His pea hybridization experiments pioneered the scientific study of heredity. Through rigorous experimental design and mathematical analysis, he discovered the fundamental laws of inheritance, laying the foundation for later molecular biology and genetic engineering. His work embodies the essence of the scientific method: precise observation, quantitative analysis, and bold hypotheses. Mendel's research not only transformed the direction of biological development but also provided theoretical support for agricultural breeding and medical research.

critic.zh: 批评者指出孟德尔的研究存在方法论上的局限性，他选择的豌豆性状过于简单，可能无法完全代表复杂的遗传现象。此外，他的数据统计可能存在'美化'处理，以支持他的理论。孟德尔未能将他的发现与当时已知的细胞学知识相结合，错过了将遗传学与细胞学联系起来的机会。他的理论在发表后长期被忽视，也反映了他在科学传播和学术网络建设上的不足。
critic.en: Critics point out limitations in Mendel's methodology. The traits he selected in peas were overly simple and may not fully represent complex genetic phenomena. Additionally, his statistical data may have been 'cleaned' to support his theories. Mendel failed to connect his findings with existing cytological knowledge, missing the opportunity to link genetics with cytology. The long neglect of his theories after publication also reflects shortcomings in scientific communication and academic networking.

objective.zh: 从历史角度看，孟德尔的工作代表了科学史上一个典型的'超前发现'案例。他的理论超越了当时科学界的理解能力，直到1900年才被德弗里斯、科伦斯和切尔马克三位科学家独立重新发现。孟德尔的故事已成为科学史上的经典案例，展示了科学发现的偶然性与必然性交织的复杂过程。在流行文化中，他被塑造成孤独天才的形象，象征着突破常规思维的科学精神，同时也反映了科学进步往往需要时间验证的客观规律。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Mendel's work represents a classic case of a 'precocious discovery' in scientific history. His theories surpassed the understanding of his contemporaries and were only independently rediscovered in 1900 by Hugo de Vries, Carl Correns, and Erich von Tschermak. Mendel's story has become a classic case study in scientific history, illustrating the complex interplay of chance and necessity in scientific discovery. In popular culture, he is portrayed as a lonely genius, symbolizing the scientific spirit of breaking conventional thinking, while also reflecting the objective reality that scientific progress often requires time for validation.

self.zh: 我的实验表明，在植物杂交中，性状的传递遵循数学规律。
self.en: My experiments have shown that in plant hybrids, the transmission of traits follows mathematical laws.
